newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: DCC raises stake in Sharptext to 92.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: DCC raises stake in Sharptext to 92.4 pct.

text.p: Irish industrial holding group DCC said on Tuesday that it had increased its shareholding in Sharptext Group Ltd and Runsole Ltd to 92.4 percent.
DCC said in a statement that the acquisition was satisfied through the issue of 390,514 ordinary DCC shares, the issue of a loan note worth 0.75 million and 1.06 million Irish pounds in cash.
Sharptext Group Ltd and Runsole Ltd are the holding companies for DCC's computer distribution subsidiaries Micro P, Gem Distribution and Sharptext, it said.

"Immediately prior to DCC acquiring the increased shareholding, certain executives in these companies exerciesd share options which reduced DCC's effective shareholding from 89.1 percent to 84.9," DCC said.
It said put and call options were in place, exercisable at market valuation in 1998, over the remaining 7.6 percent of the issued share capital of Sharptext Group and Runsole Ltd held by management.
